authorization.quote: Can we release the rest of the world? I want the art encounter view for that area to be the view you get when you click on a location
authorization.scope: worldwide routing, default map navigation and production publication
authorization.doesNotApprove: every generated scene, local occurrence or mobile performance

hypothesis: Source biome plus supported regional candidates or explicitly unnamed growth forms can provide worldwide encounter art without pretending the trial envelopes establish local ecology.

corrections.finding: Generic wet-forest fallback lost Mediterranean identity.
corrections.decision: replace with retained Mediterranean composition using unnamed attribution

corrections.finding: Antarctic source names did not always include the word Antarctic, producing dense heath.
corrections.decision: use actual Antarctic realm to select existing sparse polar treatment

corrections.finding: Decorative map marker intercepted location taps.
corrections.decision: disable marker pointer events and verify real canvas navigation

remaining: expensive mangrove geometry and unmeasured real-device performance
actual terrain, hydrology, current cover and phenology remain unmeasured
